output_text:
**local-infrastructure**: Docker-based, license-free .NET testing stack (SQL Server 2025 Developer, PostgreSQL 16 Alpine, Azure Service Bus Emulator, .NET 8 monitor). Requires Docker Compose v2+, PowerShell 5.1+, C#/.NET 8; Docker Engine, Rancher Desktop, or Podman (no Docker Desktop required).

Files: `.env.example`→`.env`, `.gitignore`, `docker-compose.yml`, `stack.ps1`, `README.md`, `Config.example.json`→`Config.json`, `Program.cs`, `ServiceBusMonitor.csproj`; `.env`/`Config.json` git-ignored.

Commands:
```
.\stack.ps1 start
.\stack.ps1 stop
.\stack.ps1 restart
.\stack.ps1 nuke
.\stack.ps1 status
.\stack.ps1 logs [service]
.\stack.ps1 pull
.\stack.ps1 monitor
docker compose up -d
docker compose down
docker compose down -v
cd servicebus/monitor
```
`nuke` and `docker compose down -v` delete data.

Copy `.env.example` → `.env` and fill in all placeholder values. **Never commit `.env`** (it is in `.gitignore`).
